subject.title: Add Claude Daily Routines usage toggle

question: Should CodexBar adopt a Claude-specific persisted visibility control for one quota window, rather than require users to use the existing global extra-usage switch?
rationale: The patch is technically narrow and preserves existing behavior, but it creates new user-facing settings policy; the linked feature request is explicitly marked as requiring maintainer product review.

options.title: Accept the narrow Claude toggle
options.body: Approve the default-on display-only setting because it follows the existing provider-specific visibility pattern and does not change upgrade behavior.

options.title: Prefer a generalized quota-window design
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want a cross-provider visibility model before adding another provider-specific preference.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow Claude toggle
recommendation.body: Approve the default-on display-only setting because it follows the existing provider-specific visibility pattern and does not change upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and the linked request’s unresolved product-decision status make this the most likely routing point.
